concepts.gloss_en: Raising up the fallen faith (which produces converts/gerim)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same lesson (lm2:5) and share the identical core phrase 'שמעלין אמונה הנפולה' — raising the fallen faith to make converts. The second one just appends 'ונחלש אמונתם' (and weakening their beliefs) as an extension of the very same act; it is not a different word or concept. Same vocalization, same context, safe merge.
